sections.heading: Aunque: indicative or subjunctive
sections.body:
*Aunque* (although / even if / even though) changes meaning with the mood:

- **Indicative** — you present the obstacle as a real, new fact: *Aunque está cansado, sigue trabajando.* (Although he's tired — and he is — he keeps working.)
- **Present subjunctive** — hypothetical ("even if") or a fact that doesn't matter / is already known: *Aunque esté cansado, tiene que terminar.* (Even if he's tired / tired or not, he has to finish.) *Aunque no te guste, es la verdad.*
- **Imperfect subjunctive** — unlikely or contrary to fact: *Aunque tuviera dinero, no lo compraría.* (Even if I had money — I don't — I wouldn't buy it.)

sections.heading: A pesar de
sections.body: *A pesar de* (despite) + noun or infinitive: *A pesar de la lluvia, salimos.* *A pesar de estar cansada, fue a la fiesta.* With a clause: *a pesar de que* + indicative (fact) or subjunctive (hypothetical / irrelevant), like *aunque*: *A pesar de que estudió mucho, no aprobó.*

sections.heading: Por mucho que / por más que
sections.body: "However much / no matter how much": *Por mucho que estudies, no vas a aprobar sin práctica.* *Por más que lo intento, no me sale.* (No matter how hard I try, I can't do it — here indicative: real, repeated attempts.) Also: *por muy* + adjective + *que*: *Por muy difícil que sea, lo voy a intentar.* (However hard it is…)

sections.heading: Other ways to concede
sections.body: *Aun así* (even so): *Es caro. Aun así, lo quiero.* *De todas formas / de todos modos* (anyway): *No me invitaron, pero voy a ir de todas formas.* *Si bien* (although — formal writing): *Si bien es cierto que…*

vocab: I manage it / it works out for me
examples: Aunque está cansado, sigue trabajando.
Although he's tired, he keeps working.
Aunque esté cansado, tiene que terminar.
Even if he's tired, he has to finish.
Aunque no te guste, es la verdad.
Whether you like it or not, it's the truth.
Aunque tuviera dinero, no lo compraría.
Even if I had money, I wouldn't buy it.
A pesar de la lluvia, salimos.
Despite the rain, we went out.
A pesar de estar cansada, fue a la fiesta.
Despite being tired, she went to the party.
A pesar de que estudió mucho, no aprobó.
Even though he studied a lot, he didn't pass.
Por mucho que estudies, no vas a aprobar sin práctica.
However much you study, you won't pass without practice.
Por más que lo intento, no me sale.
No matter how hard I try, I can't do it.
Por muy difícil que sea, lo voy a intentar.
However hard it is, I'm going to try.
Es caro. Aun así, lo quiero.
It's expensive. Even so, I want it.
No me invitaron, pero voy a ir de todas formas.
They didn't invite me, but I'm going anyway.
Si bien es cierto que es caro, la calidad es excelente.
While it's true that it's expensive, the quality is excellent.
Aunque llueva mañana, iremos a la playa.
Even if it rains tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
Aunque sea tarde, llámame.
Even if it's late, call me.
De todos modos, gracias por tu esfuerzo.
Anyway, thanks for your effort.
